comparability.baseline_source: Prior validated teacher/student batch; evaluator extension adds deterministic branch substitutions, covered by exact actor-input tests.

method.standing: Zero command for all 120 s from fixed nominal initial state on a pure plane; no push, actuator delay or physical randomization. One environment and seed 42.
method.windows: Half-open [40,80), [80,120), [40,120) seconds from telemetry sim_time_seconds. Position fields are post-step.
method.displacement: Euclidean world-XY last-minus-first position; path sums all consecutive XY distances. Velocity fit is least-squares world-XY position slope.
method.velocity_bias: Student estimate minus actual velocity from the same pre-action snapshot, in m/s after dividing observation scale 2.0.
method.intervention: Swap all three scaled linear velocity components OR the latent block only, preserving current observation input and fixed actor weights.
method.interpretation: This is a closed-loop intervention; each controller produces its own state trajectory. Unexecuted shadow outputs are not independent closed-loop trials.

limitations: Single seed and nominal pure-plane standing only; not a multi-seed robustness or hardware test.
All three linear velocity components were replaced together; no isolated vx causality claim.
Noise-on true-velocity case retains substantial small motion; small net displacement does not imply motionless standing.
Identifies sensitivity to velocity estimation inputs in these cases, not an algorithm implementation bug or optimal training hyperparameter.
Teacher movement tracking and straight-line issues from the previous batch remain unresolved.
